title: Kegerator Temperature and CO2 Health
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kegerator:pour
| stats latest(fridge_temp_c) as temp, latest(co2_psi) as co2
| eval temp_ok=if(temp>=2 AND temp<=5,"good","check"), co2_ok=if(co2>=8 AND co2<=14,"good","check")
description: Checks that your kegerator is holding serving temperature and carbonation pressure, the two things that ruin a pint when they drift.
value: Warm beer and flat or over-carbonated pours both come from a neglected kegerator; monitoring temperature and pressure keeps every pour right.
implementation: Ingest fridge temperature and regulator pressure; surface simple good-or-check states for each.
visualization: Single-value panels for serving temperature and CO2 pressure.
grandmaExplanation: It checks that your beer fridge is cold enough and the gas pressure is right, so every pint tastes good.
